author: Praxis IV
title: Entropy-gated DAQB @ Ridge: gate=0.50, k_entropy=12 (k=50,kd=22,δ=0.10,λ=0.605,α_g=0.50,seed=0)
abstract: Introduces a parsimonious label-free gate on cross-batch quota modulation using small-k batch entropy: f_cross = base + ((inv_dense−0.5)*2·δ)·m, with m=(1−gate)+gate·s, s∈[0,1]. Tests gate=0.50, k_entropy=12 at the frozen ridge. Guardrails: accept only if ≥+0.001 over 0.7414 with cLISI non-decreasing and Graph_conn ≥ reference−0.002.
